clm_6f028314f0.text: Any comparison sort requires Omega(n log n) comparisons in the worst case.

clm_f865f28e6d.text: Insertion sort runs in O(n + inversions); it is linear on nearly-sorted input.

clm_39f69af74f.text: Quicksort's worst case is O(n^2), but median-of-three pivoting avoids it on sorted/reversed inputs.
